svg.title: PagedRow on four positions
svg.text: PagedRow: page_shift = 4, so each page holds 16 positions
cache rows, page by page (row = page × 16 + offset); amber: the four rows above
Positions 0–15 of the sequence are in page 3, 16–31 in page 8, and so on; the pages need not be in order.
position >> page_shift is position / 16: the page table entry; it holds the physical page
page << page_shift is the page's first row; | (position & 15) adds position % 16
the CPU computes the same row for each new token's cache_rows
